calls.video_title: 2 MUST OWN ETFs as Tech Stocks CRASH
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked HDV call for Mark Roussin; no flip) — iShares Core High Dividend ETF is the second of the video's '2 MUST OWN ETFs' and remains an important holding: higher-yield, more defensive complement to SCHD and to growth/tech. Up 24% YTD stated (vs SPY +11%). No share price stated.
calls.base_case: Tracks the Morningstar Dividend Yield Focus Index; emphasis on high-yield payers meeting financial criteria; 3%+ yield, 0.08% expense ratio, ~80 holdings, top sectors staples, energy, healthcare and utilities — the four best performers the past month — with tech only ~1%.
calls.bull_case: Its defensive sector mix has benefited while tech has sold off (QQQ down >6% in two weeks stated, S&P 500 down ~2%), giving a growth portfolio a different return driver.
calls.bear_case: Concentrated: top 10 are 55% (XOM, CVX, ABBV, VZ, PG, PM, HD, KO, PEP, MO stated) and energy concentration means a sharp oil fall could hit it even if other defensive holdings stay stable; it lacks SCHD's dividend-growth record and is not a substitute for a fully diversified portfolio.
